paper.title_en: Bag Parameters for Heavy Meson Lifetimes from a Lattice QCD Calculation at the <math display="inline"><mrow><mi>SU</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><msub><mrow><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></math>-symmetric Point
paper.abstract_en: We calculate the dimension-six <math display="inline"><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>Q</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></math> four-quark matrix elements describing heavy-meson lifetime ratios using the gradient flow with its short flow-time expansion (SFTX) as a renormalization procedure. On six RBC/UKQCD <math display="inline"><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math>-flavor domain-wall fermion ensembles, we determine flowed bag parameters for physical charm and strange quarks and match to the <math display="inline"><mover accent="true"><mi>MS</mi><mo stretchy="true">¯</mo></mover></math> scheme with perturbative SFTX coefficients through next-to-next-to-leading order (NNLO). A multiscale matching procedure using renormalization-group running improves the extrapolation to zero flow time. For the operators relevant to <math display="inline"><mi>τ</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>D</mi><mi>s</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>/</mo><mi>τ</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msup><mi>D</mi><mn>0</mn></msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></math> at the <math display="inline"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>SU</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">F</mi></msub></mrow></math> symmetric point, we obtain <math display="inline"><mrow><msubsup><mrow><mi>B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>MS</mi></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true">¯</mo></mrow></mover></mrow></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mtext> </mtext><mtext> </mtext><mi>GeV</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>1.0524</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>97</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math>, <math display="inline"><mrow><msubsup><mrow><mi>B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>MS</mi></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true">¯</mo></mrow></mover></mrow></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mtext> </mtext><mtext> </mtext><mi>GeV</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mn>0.9621</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>70</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math>, <math display="inline"><mrow><msubsup><mrow><mi>ε</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>MS</mi></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true">¯</mo></mrow></mover></mrow></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mtext> </mtext><mtext> </mtext><mi>GeV</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>0.2275</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>76</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math>, and <math display="inline"><mrow><msubsup><mrow><mi>ε</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow><mrow><mover accent="true"><mrow><mi>MS</mi></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="true">¯</mo></mrow></mover></mrow></msubsup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>3</mn><mtext> </mtext><mtext> </mtext><mi>GeV</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>0.0005</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mn>8</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></math> using a specific choice of evanescent operators. This is the first lattice-QCD determination of <math display="inline"><mi mathvariant="normal">Δ</mi><mi>Q</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> four-quark operators with a full error budget. It opens the path toward higher-precision predictions of heavy-meson lifetimes and similar quantities exhibiting operator mixing under renormalization.
